title: 月球基地
subject: A cozy friendly small lunar base consists of ONE rounded dome building, ONE simple wide connecting corridor, and ONE small simplified landing capsule. The base has only ONE large door and ONE large window. ONE broad curved rocky lunar ground shape, with NO crater pattern or pebbles. No panels, rivets, antennas, pipes, small equipment or repeated windows. Make the dome feel welcoming and the composition charming and storybook-like through organic curves and a playful tilted little capsule, with large blank areas.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished professional SIMPLE children's coloring-book illustration, square 1024x1024, for an Android tablet coloring game ages 5–12. Expert illustrator's warm expressive organic drawing with confident flowing curves, tasteful varied line weight and charming asymmetry; never geometric clip-art parts or a diagram. Make the main character or vehicle big, around 70–80% of the image, with a memorable playful pose and one clear amusing story beat. Only 10–16 LARGE enclosed white colorable shapes across the ENTIRE picture, hard maximum 20 including the background. Keep every colorable area broad and easy for a child's finger, no tiny enclosed islands. Use expressive solid-black simple eyes WITHOUT tiny white highlights, and open smile curves; large simple facial shapes. Omit decorative texture, fur tufts, narrow stripes, dense details, screws, tiny windows, scales, grass blades, confetti and background ornaments. Add only 1–2 BIG simple secondary props that support the scene. Background nearly empty WHITE, perhaps one broad sweeping ground/cloud curve and one large simple sun/star, never a detailed scene. Crisp clean bold BLACK outlines on pure WHITE: roughly 6px outer contours and 4px interior at 1024px, continuous CLOSED boundaries, generous blank coloring areas. No gray shading, color, gradient, hatching, sketch/construction marks, paper texture, text, logo, border, or watermark. Keep main subject and appendages inside safe white margins; no cropped character. Finished professional Q-cute children's picture-book ink line art: simpler linework and fewer bigger color blocks, lively and lovable rather than mechanically assembled.

Subject: An EMPTY welcoming MOON BASE consisting ONLY of one huge smooth hemispherical dome, one smaller plump oval pod, and one very short wide connecting passage. ABSOLUTELY NO PEOPLE, NO astronaut, NO animal, NO character in doorway, NO furniture or interior objects. The dome's ONE huge arched doorway is completely EMPTY white and has exactly ONE outline, NO outer arch trim/frame/inner arch. Its ONE huge round window has exactly ONE circle, no double rim. Smaller pod is ONE smooth oval silhouette with ONE huge round window, no legs/feet/fins/nose band/seams. The broad short passage completely fills the gap between buildings down to their bottom baseline; no skinny white wedge or coupling rings. Buildings plain and unpatterned, no face needed. No ground curve,craters,stones,antenna,solar panels,stairs,flags or decorative props.

The ENTIRE illustration contains approximately8 LARGE white compartments. Keep it bold and very simple while organic and charming like a soft toy playhouse. Every white region fits a100/1000 circle. Domes large and slightly asymmetrical with confident expert picture-book contours and generous pure white safe margins. All major outer contours and architecture bases fully CLOSED so interiors remain separate from background.
